description: Returns a single snapshot including its captured table config.

created_by_name.description: Creator display name from the company directory; null until the build worker resolves it (or if the directory lookup fails). Clients fall back to created_by_user_id.

hierarchy_view.description: The view (structured | flat) the snapshot was created in. Null when the hierarchy was off at creation or the snapshot predates the field.

fiscal_year_start.description: Company fiscal-year start month at create. Null when the snapshot predates the field.

plan_window_years.description: Company plan window year count at create. Null when the snapshot predates the field.

plan_window_start_year.description: Label of the first fiscal year in the plan window at create (the calendar year it ends in). Null when the snapshot predates the field.

503.description: The permission check could not be completed (`AUTHORIZATION_UNAVAILABLE`) — safe to retry
